change_reason: New component benchmark uses only implemented policy comparators; placeholder fixed-order names are excluded.
primary_population: Events with at least one affected candidate node
information_contract: All policies receive the same risk interval, 12 nodes, 24 scenario ensemble, consequence weights and budget. Adaptive methods receive each simulated binary result only after test selection.
hidden_truth_contract: Hidden scenario sampled after policy inputs frozen; no selector accesses it before choosing a test.
pass_rule: At budget 3 on nonempty events, SDAIF passes if paired mean Coverage@3 is no more than 0.02 below strongest declared comparator. Superiority requires paired bootstrap lower bound above zero.
claim_boundary: Surface-water microbial context and simulated Net3 reach are separate evidence tracks. No paired drinking-water E. coli, real-city performance, or field validation.
